body.name: Exact branch linear programs
body.construction: For every sign map \(\zeta:\mathcal C_G\to\{+,-\}\), minimize and maximize \(q^\top(s-b)\) subject to \(b_c\in\mathcal P_c^{\zeta(c)}\) for all \(c\), and, when pins are requested, \(H(s-b)=t\). Discard infeasible branches and take the extrema over the remaining branches.
